ashok: Ran a perf + flamegraph pass on the node that saw the KV-cache eviction spikes. Found a weird prefetch gating path increasing Python time around batch assembly. Details below.

maria: nice — link? :eyes:

ashok: perf report shows ~45% time in python function build_batch -> pick_kernel_for_batch. Off-CPU looks fine, but syscalls from tokenization are spiking. Attaching sample:

ashok: ```
# top stacks by sample
build_batch (python) 45%
pick_kernel_for_batch 18%
_tokenize_input 12%
kv_cache::lookup 8%
sched::wake 5%
```

ciara: is pick_kernel_for_batch doing model feature detection (seq_len vs dims)? we recently added prefetch_gating flag right?

ashok: yeah, pick_kernel runs heuristics that check cache hits, seq distribution, and GPU kernel availability. The new prefetch_gating defers prefetch when KV-cache miss rate > 0.3 which triggers extra python branching. suspect the hot path is repeated calls into kernel selector causing many small python->C transitions.

jon: can you repro with a microbench? also share perf script and flame link.

ashok: microbench attached: `perf record -a -g -- python -u tests/perf/micro_batch_repro.py --model small --trace` and flamegraph at https://perf.example.com/2234567890 (perf data shows deep python frames from lru_cache eviction callback)

maria: quick hack idea: move prefetch gating into C extension so we avoid callback per-token. Worth a try.

ciara: also try aggregating kernel selection: honor 'batching_window_ms' to wait 2ms to form bigger batches, reduces pick_kernel frequency.

ashok: agreed. I'll test 2ms window and a C-level gate. If both help we can ship toggle via runtime flag `runtime.prefetch_gate_mode=offload_c`.

perf-bot: perfbot: benchmark run 2234567890 completed — batch latency p50 +12% with prefetch_gating on, -3% with 2ms window. See /perf/2234567890/report

ashok: filing a tiny RFC + PR for moving gating to C + default batching_window_ms=2 for small models. cc @maria @ciara

maria: looks good, add unit test for race on kv cache eviction.

jon: :thumbsup:
